title: Detailed train
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sky' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#3a2a5a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#5a3a7a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- rails -->
  <rect x='4' y='86' width='92' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a94b0'/>
  <rect x='4' y='93' width='92' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#6a7490'/>
  <!-- sleepers -->
  <g fill='#7a5a3a'>
    <rect x='10' y='84' width='4' height='13' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='24' y='84' width='4' height='13' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='38' y='84' width='4' height='13' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='52' y='84' width='4' height='13' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='66' y='84' width='4' height='13' rx='1'/>
    <rect x='80' y='84' width='4' height='13' rx='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <g fill='#c8ccd8' stroke='#5a6280' stroke-width='2'>
    <circle cx='78' cy='80' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='80' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='42' cy='80' r='7'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='80' r='6'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#4a5270'>
    <circle cx='78' cy='80' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='80' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='42' cy='80' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='80' r='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- coach body -->
  <rect x='18' y='42' width='70' height='34' rx='5' fill='#d84040'/>
  <rect x='18' y='42' width='70' height='8' rx='4' fill='#f07070'/>
  <rect x='18' y='68' width='70' height='8' rx='4' fill='#a82828'/>
  <!-- windows -->
  <g fill='#a8e8ff'>
    <rect x='24' y='52' width='12' height='12' rx='2'/>
    <rect x='41' y='52' width='12' height='12' rx='2'/>
    <rect x='58' y='52' width='12' height='12' rx='2'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#e8f6ff'>
    <rect x='24' y='52' width='12' height='4' rx='2'/>
    <rect x='41' y='52' width='12' height='4' rx='2'/>
    <rect x='58' y='52' width='12' height='4' rx='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='74' y='50' width='10' height='24' rx='2' fill='#f0c060'/>
  <rect x='78' y='60' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#a87820'/>
  <!-- cab window -->
  <rect x='19' y='52' width='3' height='12' rx='1' fill='#a8e8ff'/>
  <!-- smokestack -->
  <rect x='22' y='30' width='10' height='13' rx='2' fill='#404a68'/>
  <rect x='20' y='28' width='14' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a6488'/>
  <!-- chimney front lamp -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='26' r='3' fill='#ffe070'/>
  <!-- smoke puffs -->
  <g fill='#b8bce0'>
    <circle cx='24' cy='20' r='4'/>
    <circle cx='18' cy='14' r='5'/>
    <circle cx='13' cy='8' r='3.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- cowcatcher -->
  <path d='M18 78 L8 84 L18 84 Z' fill='#9098b8'/>
  <!-- headlamp -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='74' r='2.5' fill='#fff0a0'/>
</svg>
